//: ADR-020. THE declared source of truth for the Ticket/Case vocabularies. Consumed by the DDL (CHECK constraints) and by the modules' TypeScript unions, both PROJECTED from here by `pnpm gen:case-vocabularies` — never hand-listed. Same asymmetry as notice-types: the TS is rewritten, the DDL is VERIFIED and never rewritten, because an applied migration is immutable.

ticket_channel.//: CAS-01. How the report arrived. `external` is last and deliberately vague: an integration nobody has built yet still has to land somewhere, and inventing its name now would be a guess.

ticket_disposition.//: The ACT each assertion records (GEN-055 D0). RENAMED from opened/triaged/escalated/closed/reopened, because the same literals were doing double duty as the lifecycle: `disposition AS lifecycle_state` made a state check written against an act literal type-check and silently match — the GEN-040 defect on tickets. Now no literal appears in both.

ticket_message_visibility.//: ADR-020 D5. Exactly two values, immutable once written. The resident projection filters on this column ALONE.

case_state.//: WHAT THE CASE IS. Widened at GEN-055 with assigned, awaiting_external and resolved; `reopened` stays as GEN-038 computes it (a reopen is a new assertion whose state is `reopened`, which the next status act leaves). `pending_verification` is entered by staff or by recordExternalCompletion and NEVER advances by itself; `closed` is reached only by a human closeCase from pending_verification or resolved.

ticket_status.//: WHAT THE TICKET IS (GEN-055 D0), carried per assertion; ticket_current reads lifecycle_state off it. Disjoint from ticket_disposition by construction. `reopened` is not a state: reopening is an act that returns the ticket to `open`.

ticket_closure_reason.//: Why a ticket was closed. Disjoint from both other ticket vocabularies.

ticket_reopen_reason.//: Why a closed ticket was reopened. REQUIRED on reopenTicket.

case_disposition.//: THE ACT each case assertion records (GEN-055 D0) — cases had a state and no act vocabulary. Disjoint from case_state.

case_closure_reason.//: Why a case was closed. REQUIRED on closeCase.

case_reopen_reason.//: Why a closed case was reopened. REQUIRED on reopenCase.
